title: FBI-UAP-D013, Washington State ‘UFO’ Investigation, 1952-1960
what_is_it: A collection of memoranda and correspondence between the FBI and the U.S. Air Force regarding UFO sightings investigated in Washington State over an eight-year period.
interpretation_warnings: No extracted text was available from the PDF — likely a scanned document with poor OCR quality. All facts are derived from metadata and the official CSV description only.
Without the full document text, named individuals, specific sighting details, and exact dates of individual incidents cannot be identified.
The actual content and conclusions of the FBI-Air Force correspondence are unknown from metadata alone.
